page.overview:
Who is Karakal?

Karakal, also known as Karakal of Flames, is a fictional entity created by Sandy Petersen for the Call of Cthulhu supplement H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands, depicted as being one of the Great Ones, the gods of Earth that reside in Kadath. He is believed to be the lord of fire and is said to have a handsome face, to be bare-chested, and to be enveloped in blazing flames.

He is primarily worshipped by magicians and is served by a species known as the Minions of Karakal. He also occasionally leaves Kadath and travels in disguise. (: H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands)

He might also be the same being as Zo-Kalar.(: "The Crawler of Pnoth") However, both are usually regarded as independent deities. (: H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands)

Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Other Supernatural Beings
